# Camp Resource: Mirelurk Steamer

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Feb 19, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Sep 11, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_697f3b05253a4eeba49c957eaa43ccc7~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __Mette__

__Mirelurk Steamer__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d2b2009548504a748d0d539c67d6a6dd~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: SugarBombs.RADS

*Have that perfectly prepared delicious Mirelurk meal of your dreams with the Mirelurk Steamer.*

__Overview__

A decorative CAMP resource that passively produces Mirelurk-based food buffs. Does not require power and can be locked. Ideal for Carnivore builds looking to boost AP, defense, and carry weight.

## **__Function__**

__Function__

| **Item Produced** | **Buff Type** | **Base Effect** | **Carnivore** | **Carnivore + SIN** | **Drop Rate** | 
| Roasted Mirelurk Meat | Max AP | +10 Max AP | +20 Max AP | +25 Max AP | 25% | 
| Cooked Softshell Meat | Max AP | +20 Max AP | +40 Max AP | +50 Max AP | 25% | 
| Mirelurk Jerky | Damage Resistance | +15 DR | +30 DR | +38 DR | 25% | 
| Smoked Mirelurk Fillets | Carry Weight | +30 lbs | +60 lbs | +75 lbs | 25% | 

- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: Raider Mirelurk Boil
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 2

__Crafting Requirements__

- 3x Steel
- 2x Wood

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 10 pounds of Mirelurk food items

__How to Unlock__

- Atom Shop: 
 - Mirelurk Steamer: 500 Atoms
 - Disaster Dock Bundle: 1800 Atoms (includes Steamer)
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

Related Links:

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
